2131-4574-4659-6900--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
2131-4574-4659-6900--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

1417-1829-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1417-1829-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire, Bridge from Below and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Bridge from Below ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1864-2034-4720.description:
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep token for each mana spent to cast it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prossh, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Prossh from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Kobolds of Kher Keep tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast three times by paying {6}, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Kobolds of Kher Keep token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 7 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.

147-2292-3085.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2724-3080-4608-5625.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five enchantments.
An opponent cannot block and kill Phelia.

When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.

When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

Resolve the copy of the Helm of the Host trigger, creating two token copies of Kirol that aren't legendary.
Holding priority, activate the Kirol token by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and The Third Doctor.

When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.

When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.

Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.

Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
